name: otp
title: Verification Codes
description: One-time codes from your recent text messages, newest first. Enter pastes the code into the app in front.
author: pal

settings.label: Look back
settings.description: How many hours of messages to scan for codes.

settings.label: Ignore senders
settings.description: Senders whose messages are never listed, as Messages shows them (a shortcode like AKBANK, a number, an email). Case does not matter.

settings.label: Messages database
settings.description: The chat.db to read. ~ is expanded.

settings.label: Contacts database
settings.description: An AddressBook-v22.abcddb whose names replace phone numbers; empty means every source under ~/Library/Application Support/AddressBook.

otp.description: Codes from the last day of messages, Today and Earlier.

latest-code.title: Latest code
latest-code.description: The newest verification code on the strip for a minute after it arrives; a click copies it.

store.tagline: One-time codes from your texts, newest first; Enter pastes
features: Reads Messages' own database (`~/Library/Messages/chat.db`), one read-only query per listing, the last 24 hours by default
A message counts when it names a code (code, kod, şifre, OTP, PIN, verification, `G-123456`) and carries 4 to 8 digits that are not an amount, a date or a phone number
The sender as Messages knows it, a contact's name for a number or email in Contacts, the code as a green tag with how long ago it arrived
Live: the code that just arrived is the first row and a root result; Today and Earlier sections
A bar item that shows the newest code for a minute after it arrives; a click copies it

screenshots.caption: The codes of the day and earlier: the sender, the message, the code as a tag, when it came
The detail pane: the whole message, the code, the sender, when it was received
Paste the code into the app in front, copy it, or copy the sender
On the menu bar: the code that just arrived, in green, for a minute
The same item on a light menu bar
No popover: a click copies the code and the HUD says so
On sketchybar: the key glyph and the code, both green

actions.title: Paste code
actions.description: Hides, then pastes into the app that was in front.
